description: Use when you need a US public company's SEC EDGAR filings and key financials by ticker or CIK: latest filings (form, dates, accession, link; filter by form, since) plus latest XBRL facts: revenue. Returns the paid x402 request for your input (GET /sec/filings, $0.003 per call; schema linked). Call that URL with an x402 or MPP client to get the data. Bad input is refused before any charge. For several companies at once use sec_filings_batch. First call each day returns the data itself, free; later calls return the paid request.

cik.description: SEC Central Index Key, e.g. 320193 (send this or ticker)

form.description: optional comma list of form types to keep, e.g. 10-K,10-Q,8-K

periods.description: n = 1-10: also return the last n full fiscal years of every fact, plus ttm where it can be derived; the response grows with n; not with facts=0

quarters.description: n = 1-20: also return the last n quarters of every fact (quarter-only values, derived ones marked), plus ttm where it can be derived; the response grows with n; not with facts=0

ticker.description: stock ticker, e.g. AAPL or BRK.B (send this or cik)

name: sec_filings
title: SEC filings
